clue.text: Eg Truman's protest about Republican getting army backing

definitions.note: read as 'for example, Truman is': Harry Truman was a member of the US party of the left

parts.note: a demo is a protest march
C is short for circa, about

indicators.note: backing means the army's letters are read in reverse order

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: A political story: President Truman's protest against a Republican who has military support.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns TA (the Territorial Army, a British reserve force) into AT. The 's in 'Truman's' stands for 'is', so the definition reads 'for example, Truman is one'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: President Truman belonged to the Democratic Party, so he was one of its members.

clue.text: Unscrambles notes about Eliot's first poems

indicators.note: about means the two notes surround Eliot's initial

parts.note: D and C are two musical notes

indicators.note: first means just the initial letter of Eliot

parts.note: odes are lyric poems

explanation.surface: Someone deciphers notes on T S Eliot's early poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: works out the meaning of coded messages, deciphers.

clue.text: Self-advancing tactics? It's what non-sporty schoolkids do?

definitions.meaning: psychological manipulation used to gain an advantage over a rival
children who dislike sport object to, or ... lessons

explanation.surface: Musings on strategy and on schoolchildren who dislike PE.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits as MIND (object to) + GAMES (school sport).
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: psychological ploys used to unsettle or outwit someone.

clue.text: Hair feature well away from Essex town — not in Paris

indicators.note: away from means the word well is taken out of the town name

parts.note: Chigwell is a town in Essex, a county north-east of London
non is French for no or not

explanation.surface: A hairstyle seen well away from an Essex town, though not in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well' looks like an adverb but is removed as a word from CHIGWELL.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a knot or coil of hair worn at the back of the head.

clue.text: Strong drink and salmon consumed by everyone

indicators.note: consumed by means the fish goes inside the word for everyone

parts.note: all means everyone
coho is a Pacific species of salmon

explanation.surface: Spirits and salmon eaten by all at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: intoxicating liquor, booze in general.

clue.text: The hospital should send us this set of clothing!

definitions.text: The hospital should send us this
definitions.meaning: a patient hopes to be discharged well, i.e. sent out in good health
a set of clothes worn together, an ensemble

explanation.surface: A patient hopes the hospital will discharge them, or perhaps send them some clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as OUT FIT: a hospital should send us home out and fit.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an ensemble of garments worn together is called by this word.

clue.text: Working poet I rave about

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A poet raves about something.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: in operation, functioning, as a law that is in force.

clue.text: Singer cheers knight, one getting older

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks, like cheers
N is the chess notation for a knight
an ager is something that ages

explanation.surface: A singer toasts an ageing knight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Singer' is a songbird, not a vocalist.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a brightly coloured American songbird.

clue.text: Put at risk removing centre of blade from beard

indicators.note: removing means taking a letter out of the beard word

parts.note: an imperial is a small pointed beard below the lower lip

indicators.note: centre of means the middle letter of blade

explanation.surface: Someone endangered while shaving a beard with a blade.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to endanger or expose to danger.

clue.text: Seize boat in scam woman's initially engineered

indicators.note: in places the boat inside the run of letters that follows

parts.note: a con is a scam or swindle
Fi, short for Fiona, is a woman's name; with the 's it gives FIS

indicators.note: initially means just the first letter of engineered is taken

parts.note: a cat is a catamaran, a kind of boat

explanation.surface: A boat seized after a scam engineered by a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boat' here is a catamaran, and 'woman's' is a short female name with its possessive 's kept as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to take goods away by authority, as customs officers might.

clue.text: Work in Northumberland? Emphatically not!

indicators.note: in puts the work inside the abbreviation for the county's region

parts.note: NE, north-east: Northumberland is a county in the north-east of England
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Asked about working in Northumberland, someone flatly refuses.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang: an emphatic, casual form of no, a firm refusal.

clue.text: Possibly bitch furiously about them, being of possessive type?

parts.note: a bitch is a female dog, so 'possibly' marks it as an example

indicators.note: about means the phrase for furiously goes around them

parts.note: furiously means in anger

explanation.surface: Someone rages about a few people, perhaps calling them names, out of jealousy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'furiously' is not an anagram signal here; it is a phrase meaning 'angrily' that opens up to hold 'them'.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom from Aesop: someone who selfishly keeps something they have no use for so that others cannot have it.

clue.text: Ground-breaking tutorial cut short by head of Latin

indicators.note: cut short means the last letter of the tutorial word is dropped

parts.note: a seminar is a tutorial or small teaching group

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of Latin

explanation.surface: An innovative tutorial cut short by the head of the Latin department.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: work that is highly original and influential on what follows.

clue.text: Completely over the top, soldiers entering cultivated area

parts.note: all means completely, as in all gone

indicators.note: entering means the soldiers go inside the abbreviation

parts.note: men are soldiers, as opposed to officers

explanation.surface: Soldiers go completely over the top, charging into a field.
explanation.walkthrough: An allotment is a small rented plot for growing vegetables, common in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a garden plot rented for growing produce.

clue.text: Cross about one's king's bad government

indicators.note: about means the cross wraps around the following letters

parts.note: a mule is a cross between a donkey and a horse
one is I, and one's gives I'S
R, for rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Someone angry about a king's bad rule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like 'angry' but is the hybrid animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: poor or unjust ruling of a country.

clue.text: Disturbing, being out of bed and doing my job!

parts.note: up means out of bed
the setter's job is setting crosswords

explanation.surface: A setter complains that getting up to compose puzzles is distressing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'my' is the setter speaking: his job is setting.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: causing distress or worry.

clue.text: Part of bridge incorporating copper in Swiss city

indicators.note: incorporating means the city takes the metal's symbol inside it

parts.note: Basle (Basel) is a city in Switzerland
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A section of a bridge in a Swiss city containing copper.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a counterweighted, pivoting span of a drawbridge, as on Tower Bridge.

clue.text: Amazing article — not all you and I digested

indicators.note: digested means taken inside, so the pronoun goes within the other letters

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
some means not all
we is you and I

explanation.surface: Something amazing that only some of us have taken in.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: inspiring wonder, extremely impressive.

clue.text: What we may send, say, when ordering his Uncle Vanya?

definitions.text: What we may send, say, when ordering his Uncle Vanya?

indicators.note: say signals that the words are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: when ordering goods by post one sends a payment slip off

explanation.surface: How to pay when buying a copy of a Russian play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheque off' is said like the playwright's name; Uncle Vanya is his play.
explanation.definitionFit: Author: the Russian dramatist who wrote Uncle Vanya and The Seagull.

clue.text: Law experts tip off writers of laments

indicators.note: tip off means the first letter of the writers is removed

parts.note: an elegy is a lament, so its writers are elegists

explanation.surface: Legal experts pass a warning to poets who write sad verse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tip off' reads as 'warn' but means remove the tip.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: people learned in the law, jurists.

clue.text: Reported theatre act, having first left City desk?

indicators.note: having first places the left-and-City letters before the act

parts.note: EC is the postcode area of the City of London

indicators.note: Reported signals a word that sounds like another

parts.note: a turn is a performer's act in a variety show

explanation.surface: A desk left in the City after a theatre performance.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district, postcode EC.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a stand with a slanted top used for reading a speech or the Bible.

clue.text: Good Queen protecting weakling — a pig, possibly

indicators.note: protecting means the outer letters surround the weakling

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen
a runt is the weakest of a litter

explanation.surface: A good queen shields the weakest of the litter, a piglet.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a pig is so called for the grunting noise it makes.

clue.text: Medical instrument suppliers originally manufactured in grey

indicators.note: originally means just the first letter of suppliers
manufactured means the letters of in grey are made into something new

explanation.surface: Suppliers making medical instruments in grey.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a needle and plunger device for injecting fluids.

clue.text: Plucky types may use one, subject to current availability

definitions.text: Plucky types may use one, subject to current availability

parts.words: Plucky types may use one, subject to current availability
parts.note: plucky types are those who pluck strings; the instrument works only when a current from the mains is available

explanation.surface: Brave people may use something, as long as stock is available.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plucky' means brave on the surface, but here it means those who pluck; 'current' is electricity, not 'present'.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: an amplified, plugged-in stringed instrument that guitarists pluck.

clue.text: Boat-builder's failure to comply with GP's request?

definitions.note: read as 'boat-builder is': the biblical maker of the ark

parts.note: refusing to comply is saying no
a GP, a family doctor, asks you to say ah when looking at your throat

explanation.surface: A boatbuilder fails to do what the doctor asked.
explanation.walkthrough: A GP is a family doctor in Britain. The 's in 'Boat-builder's' stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Bible story: the patriarch who built the ark before the Flood.

clue.text: Rider managed to cross island after end of late crusade

indicators.note: after places the managed-and-island part following the earlier letters
end of means the last letter of late

parts.note: a quest is a crusade or mission

indicators.note: to cross means ran goes across, around, the island letter

parts.note: ran means managed, as in ran a business

explanation.surface: A rider succeeded in reaching an island after a late crusade.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a person on horseback, a horse rider.

clue.text: Monkey displaying great vitality at top of tree

parts.note: verve is energy and enthusiasm

indicators.note: top of means the first letter of tree, top in a down light

explanation.surface: A lively monkey up a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an African guenon, a small grey-green monkey.

clue.text: Popular soldier making comeback in valid scheme

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable

indicators.note: in places the soldier inside the word for valid

parts.note: true means valid, correct

indicators.note: making comeback means the soldier's letters run backwards

parts.note: GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A popular soldier returns as part of a legitimate plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a secret plot or crafty plan.
